import copy, hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path

root=Path('/var/tmp/work')
out=root/'corpus'
(out/'cases').mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
IMAGE='sha256:'+'a'*64
NAMES=['agent-a','agent-b','broker','receiver','reviewer','approver']
UIDS=dict(zip(NAMES,[23701,23702,23700,23700,23703,23704]))
BASIS='static hypothetical selected facts, no live deployment'

def mount(source,target,ro):
    return {'type':'bind','source':source,'target':target,'read_only':ro}

def base():
    services={}
    for name in NAMES:
        s={'image':IMAGE,'user':str(UIDS[name]),'x-cstack-role':'agent' if name.startswith('agent-') else name,'environment':{'PYTHONPATH':'/slice','SLICE_ROLE':name},'networks':['isolated'],'volumes':[mount('/workspace/channel','/channel',True)]}
        if name.startswith('agent-'):
            s.update(security_opt=['no-new-privileges:true'],cap_drop=['ALL'])
        if name=='broker': s['volumes']=[mount('/workspace/channel','/channel',False),mount('/workspace/db','/private',False)]
        if name=='receiver': s['volumes']=[mount('/workspace/db','/private',False),mount('/workspace/sink','/output',False)]
        services[name]=s
    return {'x-cstack':{'sink_source':'/workspace/sink','database_source':'/workspace/db','channel_source':'/workspace/channel','budget':2},'services':services,'networks':{'isolated':{'internal':True}}}

def inventory(c):
    result={'services':{}}
    for name,s in c['services'].items():
        u=s['user'].split(':')[0]
        result['services'][name]={'uid':int(u),'image':s['image'],'mounts':[{k:v for k,v in m.items() if k"'!='"'bind'} for m in s['volumes']],'networks':copy.deepcopy(s['networks']),'env_names':sorted(s['environment']),'hardening':{'no_new_privileges':s.get('security_opt')==['no-new-privileges:true'],'cap_drop':copy.deepcopy(s.get('cap_drop',[]))}}
    return result

cases=[]
def add(slug,label,reason,edit=lambda c:None,inv_edit=None):
    c=base(); edit(c); r=inventory(c)
    if inv_edit: inv_edit(r)
    cases.append((slug,label,reason,c,r))
S='SAFE_IN_SUPPORTED_MODEL'; F='REFUTED_CONFIGURATION'; U='UNKNOWN_CONFIGURATION'
add('supported-minimal',S,'Exact hardened reference profile; receiver has no optional channel mount.')
add('supported-receiver-channel',S,'Receiver additionally has the explicitly allowed writable channel bind.',lambda c:c['services']['receiver']['volumes'].append(mount('/workspace/channel','/channel',False)))
add('supported-agent-selinux',S,'Optional bind selinux z is used on both agent channel mounts.',lambda c:[c['services'][n]['volumes'][0].update(bind={'selinux':'z'}) for n in ['agent-a','agent-b']])
add('supported-broker-selinux',S,'Optional selinux z is used on both broker binds.',lambda c:[m.update(bind={'selinux':'z'}) for m in c['services']['broker']['volumes']])
add('supported-receiver-selinux',S,'Optional selinux z is used on receiver private and output binds.',lambda c:[m.update(bind={'selinux':'z'}) for m in c['services']['receiver']['volumes']])
add('supported-reviewer-selinux',S,'Reviewer channel uses the permitted optional selinux z bind option.',lambda c:c['services']['reviewer']['volumes'][0].update(bind={'selinux':'z'}))
add('supported-approver-selinux',S,'Approver channel uses the permitted optional selinux z bind option.',lambda c:c['services']['approver']['volumes'][0].update(bind={'selinux':'z'}))
def all_z(c):
    c['services']['receiver']['volumes'].append(mount('/workspace/channel','/channel',False))
    for s in c['services'].values():
        for m in s['volumes']: m['bind']={'selinux':'z'}
add('supported-all-binds-selinux',S,'All binds use allowed selinux z, including the optional receiver channel.',all_z)
add('agent-sink-write',F,'Agent a is directly granted a writable sink bind.',lambda c:c['services']['agent-a']['volumes'].append(mount('/workspace/sink','/output',False)))
add('agent-database-read',F,'Agent b is directly granted a database bind even though read only.',lambda c:c['services']['agent-b']['volumes'].append(mount('/workspace/db','/private',True)))
add('agent-channel-write',F,'Agent a channel mount is writable; the supported agent channel is read only.',lambda c:c['services']['agent-a']['volumes'][0].update(read_only=False))
add('reviewer-sink-write',F,'Reviewer is granted an unauthorized writable sink path.',lambda c:c['services']['reviewer']['volumes'].append(mount('/workspace/sink','/output',False)))
add('approver-database-read',F,'Approver is granted an unauthorized private database path.',lambda c:c['services']['approver']['volumes'].append(mount('/workspace/db','/private',True)))
add('agent-trusted-uid',F,'Agent a uses trusted storage-owner UID 23700 instead of its distinct UID.',lambda c:c['services']['agent-a'].update(user='23700'))
add('agents-shared-uid',F,'Agent b shares agent a UID, collapsing the two required principals.',lambda c:c['services']['agent-b'].update(user='23701'))
add('agent-role-impersonation',F,'Agent a environment selects broker role instead of its own name.',lambda c:c['services']['agent-a']['environment'].update(SLICE_ROLE='broker'))
add('agent-role-marker',F,'Agent b declares trusted receiver role instead of agent.',lambda c:c['services']['agent-b'].update({'x-cstack-role':'receiver'}))
add('agent-no-new-privileges-missing',F,'Agent a lacks required no-new-privileges declaration.',lambda c:c['services']['agent-a'].pop('security_opt'))
add('agent-cap-drop-missing',F,'Agent b lacks required drop of ALL capabilities.',lambda c:c['services']['agent-b'].pop('cap_drop'))
add('agent-no-new-privileges-disabled',F,'Agent a explicitly disables the required privilege hardening.',lambda c:c['services']['agent-a'].update(security_opt=['no-new-privileges:false']))
add('agent-partial-cap-drop',F,'Dropping one capability does not establish the required ALL capability drop.',lambda c:c['services']['agent-b'].update(cap_drop=['NET_RAW']))
add('agent-hardening-wrong-shape',F,'Agent security_opt is a scalar instead of the required exact list.',lambda c:c['services']['agent-a'].update(security_opt='no-new-privileges:true'))
add('network-not-internal',F,'The sole network explicitly lacks required internal isolation.',lambda c:c['networks']['isolated'].update(internal=False))
add('inventory-agent-uid-disagreement',F,'Synthetic inventory assigns agent a trusted UID contrary to its Compose identity; selected identity agreement is refuted.',inv_edit=lambda r:r['services']['agent-a'].update(uid=23700))
add('inventory-hardening-disagreement',F,'Synthetic inventory denies agent b no-new-privileges despite the Compose declaration; required selected hardening agreement is refuted.',inv_edit=lambda r:r['services']['agent-b']['hardening'].update(no_new_privileges=False))
add('unsupported-command',U,'Service command override is outside selected supported fields; code behavior cannot be assured.',lambda c:c['services']['broker'].update(command=['/hypothetical/alternate-program']))
add('unsupported-entrypoint',U,'Entrypoint override is outside the reviewed selected interface.',lambda c:c['services']['receiver'].update(entrypoint=['/hypothetical/alternate-entry']))
add('unsupported-build',U,'Build declaration adds unreviewed image construction semantics.',lambda c:c['services']['reviewer'].update(build={'context':'./hypothetical-source'}))
add('unsupported-healthcheck',U,'Healthcheck execution is an unsupported Compose feature.',lambda c:c['services']['approver'].update(healthcheck={'disable':True}))
add('unsupported-restart',U,'Restart policy is outside the selected supported service fields.',lambda c:c['services']['broker'].update(restart='on-failure'))
add('unsupported-resource-limits',U,'Deploy resource limits are outside the supported declaration interface.',lambda c:c['services']['agent-a'].update(deploy={'resources':{'limits':{'memory':'64M'}}}))
add('unsupported-tmpfs',U,'Tmpfs storage declaration introduces unsupported mount semantics.',lambda c:c['services']['reviewer'].update(tmpfs=['/tmp']))
add('unsupported-service-labels',U,'Service labels are not among supported selected reference fields.',lambda c:c['services']['approver'].update(labels={'example.purpose':'hypothetical'}))
add('unsupported-inventory-metadata',U,'Inventory includes unreviewed kernel metadata; this independently labeled case falls outside the selected inventory interface.',inv_edit=lambda r:r.update(kernel_metadata={'hypothetical_release':'unreviewed'}))

manifest={'author':'independent-codex-exec-tier10','basis':BASIS,'hypotheses':{'host_directories':{'/workspace/sink':{'owner_uid':23700,'mode':'0700'},'/workspace/db':{'owner_uid':23700,'mode':'0700'},'/workspace/channel':{'owner_uid':23700,'mode':'0755'}},'image_code_correspondence':'Given known-code hypothesis, not measured','principal_policy':'Given public reference policy, not measured','runtime_inventory':'Every runtime file is synthetic selected inventory, never an observation','labels':'Fixed by independent authorship before any evaluation; no evaluator used'},'cases':[]}
for slug,label,reason,c,r in cases:
    cp=f'cases/{slug}.compose.json'; rp=f'cases/{slug}.runtime.json'
    for rel,value in [(cp,c),(rp,r)]:
        (out/rel).write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\\n')
    manifest['cases'].append({'id':slug,'compose':cp,'runtime':rp,'ground_truth':label,'reason':reason})
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\\n')
notes='''# Independent static corpus author notes

The entire corpus is **static hypothetical selected facts, no live deployment**. Every runtime inventory is authored synthetic selected facts, not a real observation. Host directory ownership and modes, known image/code correspondence, and principal policy are given hypotheses from the public interface. Network declarations make no measured external egress claim.

The 34 cases comprise 8 SAFE_IN_SUPPORTED_MODEL, 17 REFUTED_CONFIGURATION, and 9 UNKNOWN_CONFIGURATION labels. Labels and reasons were authored and fixed before any evaluation. No evaluator was available, no case was scanned or scored, and no existing repository, verifier, extractor, fixture, session history, or prior evaluation was inspected. No Docker, workloads, exploit code, attack payloads, or external services were used.

Supported coverage includes the minimal receiver, optional receiver channel, and permitted SELinux z options across agent, broker, receiver, reviewer, and approver binds. Refutations cover direct sink writers, private database exposure, writable agent channels, trusted and collapsed identities, role impersonation, absent or disabled privilege hardening, partial capability drops, malformed hardening, non-internal networking, and synthetic identity/hardening disagreement. Unsupported coverage includes command and entrypoint declarations, build, healthcheck, restart, deploy resources, tmpfs, labels, and extra inventory metadata. Command/entrypoint values are inert hypothetical paths in configuration JSON, with no implementation or invocation.

All ordinary inventories mirror Compose selected fields. Bind options are intentionally omitted from inventories as specified. The two disagreement cases explicitly differ in UID or hardening and their reasons document this. The extra-metadata inventory case is independently labeled UNKNOWN. Unsupported declaration cases have no additional known unsafe condition intentionally introduced. Required hardening departures are labeled REFUTED because they fail an explicit security requirement; unrelated unsupported features are UNKNOWN.

Manifest paths are relative to corpus/. SHA256SUMS seals manifest.json and every Compose and runtime JSON, excluding itself. AUTHOR-NOTES.md and the scratch authoring generator are outside that requested JSON seal. No artifacts were modified after sealing.
'''
(root/'AUTHOR-NOTES.md').write_text(notes)
files=[out/'manifest.json']+[out/rel for row in manifest['cases'] for rel in [row['compose'],row['runtime']]]
checksum=''.join(f'{hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}  {p.relative_to(out).as_posix()}\\n' for p in sorted(files))
(out/'SHA256SUMS').write_text(checksum)
print('Authored case count:',len(cases))
print('SHA256SUMS sha256:',hashlib.sha256(checksum.encode()).hexdigest())
